newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Dec 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Dec 2.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

The Abbey National decided to increase its interest rates for the first time in two years today. Other building societies are set to follow suit, with more bad news anticipated for borrowers in the run-up to the General Election.
STERLING POWERS ON TO NEW HEIGHTS

Sterling increased to new highs against the French franc and the Deutschmark as European finance ministers gathered at the Ecofin meeting in Brussels to discuss fines for countries that break central currency rules.
Stakis, the hotels group has shut down the head office of its newly-acquired Metropole hotels in Birmingham, with the loss of 53 jobs.
CRUNCH TIME IN THE EMAP SACKINGS ROW

EMAP the media group has called an emergency general meeting of shareholders in London to vote on the sacking of two of the company's directors, following a board meeting in October at which there was an irretrievable breakdown in relations between the two non-executives and head of the group Sir John Hoskyns.
BANKS GO COOL ON FUNDING SKY DIGITAL TV

Bankers suggest that the chances of BSkyB persuading a High Street bank to subsidise the launch of digital satellite TV next autumn are falling. National Westminster Bank have followed Barclays in abandoning discussions with Sky.
